scenario: okf adapter validate(component, changes, ctx) for every non-reserved file in tests/fixtures/bundles/okf-sample/, with every OKF link resolved against the real fixture tree (no dangling links in this bundle -- see tests/fixtures/bundles/okf-sample-v2/ and tests/integration/okf-conformance.test.ts's adversarial bundle for dangling-link coverage). validate is LENIENT (§5): unknown frontmatter never fails, missing-type is INFO, missing-ref on an OKF link is a non-blocking WARNING.
specSource: docs/architecture/specs/akm-0.9.0-bundle-adapter-spec.md §5 ('validate (LENIENT): unknown frontmatter and absent optional timestamp never fail; missing-ref on OKF links is a warning; missing-type is info').
realWorldSource: tests/fixtures/bundles/okf-sample/ -- the same fixture the recognition/renderer goldens use
notes: guides/onboarding.md is the only file in this fixture with no type: frontmatter field, producing exactly one INFO diagnostic ('missing-type') that never blocks (fixed: false, detail prefixed 'info:'). Every other file carries a type and produces no missing-type diagnostic.

No file in this fixture has a dangling link -- every /-rooted and relative OKF link resolves to a real concept in the same bundle (guides/onboarding.md -> tables/orders + tables/customers; tables/orders.md -> tables/customers + metrics/wau; tables/customers.md -> tables/orders; metrics/wau.md -> tables/orders), so this golden's perType issue lists are ALL EMPTY except onboarding.md's. Dangling-link tolerance (missing-ref as a non-blocking warning) is exercised instead by the adversarial bundle in tests/integration/okf-conformance.test.ts and by tests/core/adapter/okf-adapter.test.ts's synthetic broken-link cases -- this golden pins the OTHER, equally load-bearing half: a fully-resolved bundle must NOT spuriously report missing-ref.

Reserved files (index.md, log.md, tables/index.md) are excluded before validation reaches the type/link checks -- they are not concepts, so they get no missing-type diagnostic even though none of them carry a type: field either. Base checks (unquoted-colon, missing-updated, stale-path, missing-ref in frontmatter list keys) still run against reserved files' own content, but this fixture's reserved files are well-formed and free of AKM stash-path references, so their issue lists are also empty.
